modules.name: WARP
modules.description: Curved master clock: tempo that drifts, bars that bend, four related phase outputs

modules.name: CONTOUR
modules.description: Rhythms where a curve crosses levels, with an 8-phasor interference source. Runs from a phase ramp or free, up to audio rate

modules.name: MUTATE
modules.description: 8-track step drum sequencer that writes its own patterns and slowly rewrites them: ratchets, micro-timing, conditions, per-step sound locks, polymeter

modules.name: STRIKE
modules.description: Modal percussion: 32 tuned resonators that morph from wood to rubber, metal, glass and drum skin, plus a vowel (formant) mode. Up to 8 voices

modules.name: FMX
modules.description: Four-operator FM voice whose loudness and brightness follow a phase ramp or a trigger, up to audio-rate retriggering. Up to 8 voices
